19.critic_justification: Confirmed in functions/src/billing.ts (lines 54-60). Transaction records (amount, currency, status, timestamp) are saved to Firestore under users/{uid}/payments during Stripe billing webhook processing. As purchase history is stored off-device, it must be declared in the Play Store Data Safety section under Financial Info / Purchase History.

21.critic_justification: Confirmed in LocationManager.kt (line 19) and MainViewModel+Concerts.kt (lines 31-41). When ConcertsScreen loads, fetchConcertsNearMe automatically fetches precise location using FusedLocationProviderClient with Priority.PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY and transmits lat/lon off-device to the searchConcerts Firebase Cloud Function without prior prominent disclosure or explicit user consent.

22.critic_justification: Pruned as a duplicate and unsupported finding. LocationManager.kt (line 19) specifically requests precise location via Priority.PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY (which is already verified in Finding 21). There is no separate API call or logic retrieving approximate location.
